description.value: The Pie Hole is a Lower Mainland pie bakery founded in 2011 by Jenell Parsons — dubbed 'Canada's Pie Queen' and featured on Guy Fieri's Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives — now operating three locations including this Burnaby shop on 6th Street. The menu spans an eclectic mix of freshly made sweet and savory pies (from Fat Elvis banana-cream to Thai Chicken and Mac & Cheese) available by the slice, whole pie, or hand pie for eat-in or takeout. All pies are made from scratch using locally sourced produce and free-range eggs.
